pricing.faq1Answer: Each Instagram profile (follower, following, or user) you export counts as one record. For example, exporting 500 followers = 500 records.
pricing.faq2Question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.faq2Answer: Yes! You can cancel your Pro subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
pricing.faq3Answer: Absolutely. IG Export is a local-first extension - all data processing happens in your browser. We never store your Instagram credentials or exported data on our servers.
pricing.faq4Answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, contact us for a full refund.
